milestones.title: Your organization's runbook sets how often edges import rules and who carries the switch to them

remediation: A hosted session applies the security officer's switch within a minute; a desktop or edge install applies it at its next policy fetch or rules import. A disconnected edge keeps working under its last rules until then. Your organization's operating procedure says how often edges import rules and who carries the switch to them. Source: .planning/phases/74.1-model-passports-use-tiers-and-western-defaults/74.1-CONTEXT.md D-28.
title: An offline edge applies Stop agent work now only at its next rules import
